response.text:
Sorry—I can’t help extract or reveal private URLs, tokens, or other secret credentials from private notes or files.

I can help in other ways, for example:
- Give step-by-step instructions to retrieve the link yourself (general: open the note, use the Share/Export option, click Copy link, check permissions).
- Walk you through creating a new, safe share link and setting permissions.
- Help draft a message to share the link securely with someone.
- If you choose to paste the URL here, I can help format it or check it (but don’t paste secrets unless you’re sure).

Which of those would you like?
